title: Djinni Ring

sources.title: Mage Hand
markers: | summary = It conjures a spectral hand that can interact with objects.

summary: Cast Mage Hand as an Action once per Short Rest within 60 ft. The spectral hand manipulates objects for 10 turns.

fields.Ring variant: Does not gain Mage Hand Legerdemain or the Hr’a’cknir Bracers’ bonus-action interaction. Can coexist with a separate class version.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
